name: Kővágóörs (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kővágóörs (a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, a crest and red and grey mantling) above the name KŐVÁGÓÖRS in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kővágóörs arms with helm, crest and mantling
